summary: Performance & caching validation for Hypd Games. Server-side in-memory cache working correctly: /api/games cached < 150ms, /api/categories < 90ms, /api/games/video-previews-batch < 110ms. All major frontend flows verified: home feed, explore, search, navigation, play, save/heart, admin login, feed toggle, leaderboard, profile.

critical.issue: Cache-Control header set by FastAPI ('public, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=60') is being overridden by Cloudflare to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. This means browser/CDN HTTP caching will NOT work. Only server-side in-memory caching is active.

minor.issue: First call to /api/games when 30s pre-warm cache has expired takes ~3.5s. Pre-warm TTL (30s) is too short for low-traffic environments — cache expires and next cold request hits Supabase DB. Recommend increasing TTL to 5-10min for games cache.
Console error 'Error fetching friends: TypeError: Failed to fetch' on profile page. Friends API endpoint failing.

issues: Video preview area shows solid black background for games without video URLs — could look like a loading/broken state to users. Consider showing thumbnail image as fallback.

performance_results.note: All cached calls are well within targets. Cold call fails due to 30s TTL expiry.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Performance caching implementation verified working: server-side in-memory cache reduces /api/games from 3.77s to ~150ms (cached), /api/categories to ~90ms, video batch to ~110ms. Key issue: 30s TTL causes frequent cache misses — recommend extending to 5min. Cloudflare overrides Cache-Control headers, so HTTP caching doesn't work end-to-end (only server-side in-memory cache is effective). Frontend sessionStorage caching working (30s for games, 1h for video URLs). All admin features work: login, game list, feed toggle (56 games). Admin page at /admin accessible after login. Save/Heart works with login ('Game saved!' toast). Search overlay works with live filtering. All navigation tabs work.
